meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 当你发来带本地路径的附件，Claude 会在自己的运行环境里把 Word、PPT、Excel、CSV、PDF 等转成 Markdown 文件，并告诉你文件位置；文件不上传外部服务，读取大文件时只读相关片段。
howto.when: 当你在消息里给出本地附件路径，需要把附件读出来而不上传到外部解析服务时触发。

say.text: 把附件里的 Word 文档转成 Markdown，并告诉我输出路径。
say.note: 转换后返回一个 .md 文件路径。

say.text: 如果这个 PDF 是扫描图片版，就直接说不能转。
say.note: Claude 会明确报告图片型 PDF 不支持。

say.text: 请把附件 data.csv 转成 Markdown 并读取它。
say.note: CSV 会以显式格式转换并纳入上下文。

howto.what_en: When you send an attachment with a local path, Claude runs a local tool to convert Word, PPT, Excel, CSV, PDF, etc. into a Markdown file and reports its location; files stay in the container, and large outputs are only partially read.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message provides a local attachment path that must be read without uploading to an external parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Word document to Markdown and tell me the output path.
If this PDF is a scanned image, just tell me it can't be converted.
Convert the attached data.csv to Markdown and read it.
say_en.note: CSV is parsed with an explicit format and read.
